sources.quote: 2 Ursae Minoris, also named Tarandus, is a single star a few degrees away from the northern celestial pole.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 174 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,563 K, so 21.12 solar radii.
